title: Acquisitive Podcast Ep 07
description:
Episode 07: Ross McDaniel - Digital Marketer

In this episode, Sara and Daniel talk to Ross, founder of Fencepost, a digital marketing agency for home service businesses, and owner of Trellis Coffee Bar in Augusta GA. 

Ross drops a ton of tips and tricks for analyzing a company's marketing strategy, reputation, and how to start marketing from scratch after closing on your new business!
